extraction.Name: Swallow Dinah Gary
extraction.Recorded patent: patent was recorded June 13, 1918 by the First State Bank of Wood
extraction.Buyer: Swallow Dinah Gary conveyed the land by deed to Frank Kriehn for $1.00 and other valuable consideration
extraction.NOTES: Fee patent No. 612441 issued; northeast quarter of section 22, township 42, range 27; receipt for patent signed by the allottee February 2, 1918; conveyance dated May 10, 1918
